purpose: Approximate component-group locations on the unchanged official BTT V1.1 image. Rectangles never identify an individual contact or mating-plug cavity.

regions.label: MOTOR0–3 empty driver-socket area
regions.note: This locates the four-socket group. Match the selected MOTOR number on the actual board; the highlight is not a contact position.

regions.label: A1 / A2 / B2 / B1 motor-output plugs — LEAVE EMPTY
HV / VM / VIN — REMOVE DRIVER JUMPER CAPS
Mode / SPI — REMOVE DRIVER JUMPER CAPS
POWER / MAIN POWER — identify +VIN and GND
Power-terminal block — MAIN POWER only is used
STOP bank — homes and separate drive diagnostics
regions.note: This locates the whole STOP bank. Match STOP0–3 for homes or STOP4–7 for diagnostics; the groups have different duties.

regions.label: TB / T0 / T1 — safety monitor, hold and probe
BLTouch header — tool-setter signal PB7 and its GND
EXP headers — identify EXP2 from the board marking
regions.note: Both EXP housings are highlighted. Identify EXP2 from its actual board marking before locating PB1, PB2 and GND.

regions.label: HE0 / HE1 — flood and mist/air relay controls
